name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.276.0 — Queue lanes: a free-text queue item now records which command takes it next — plan, prototype, fix or decide — when it is added, and spec-queue add refuses free text without one. The lane writes the command, so the payload carries the subject only. spec-queue next prints the lane lead above the paste line, and spec-status's Next block prints the same composed line from one shared function. Items added before lanes print as before under a no-lane warning. 7.275.0 — One runner for host commands: every place the plugin runs or prints a host's own command (gate, test, e2e, boot, db, picture, scaffold) now goes through one module that scrubs the test-runner context, quotes every spliced value one way, and hands environment values to compound commands safely; the release e2e leg now gives BASE_URL to every part of a compound e2eCommand, and a consistency test refuses any new raw shell spawn outside that module. 7.274.0 — Fix: the build replay and prototype drivers printed the boot command as `PORT=<n> <bootCommand>`, which gives PORT only to the first command of a compound line (`build && cd dir && exec server`), so the server bound its default port and readiness never passed. All three sites now print `export PORT=<n>; <bootCommand>` through one helper in the port module, pinned by a test that runs the printed line in a shell.
